verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch lets users control where data lives by self-hosting Community or Enterprise Edition on their own infrastructure, with 'full data ownership' and on-prem deployment. There is no evidence of choosing a storage region within Hoppscotch Cloud, so residency control requires running and operating your own deployment. A community report also notes you can't point workspace data to a specific local directory. Missing for 10: region/residency selection in the managed cloud offering, documented data-residency guarantees or certifications, configurable local data storage location, independent corroboration of self-host residency setups.
